mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP growth) signals strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%, signaling monetary tightening, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are expected to turn negative as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) and falling UNRATE (improving labor market) creates a dual easing environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite both FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE drop, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained FEDFUNDS decline below 2% for 3 months predicts further easing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not follow positive direction in the late-cycle expansion regime, or the regime changes before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate tighter labor markets and potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative despite UNRATE dropping below 4.0%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below 96.5 (indicating supply contraction) and FEDFUNDS declines below 2% (monetary easing), the combination predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
regime_hint: supply contraction and monetary easing regime
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative despite both INDPRO decline and FEDFUNDS decline, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening regime, a sustained UNRATE decline below 4.5% for 3 weeks signals potential stabilization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not turn positive despite UNRATE dropping below 4.5% in a tightening regime, or the effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Both quarterly GDPC1 exceeding 17222.583 (current GDP growth) and monthly RSAFS surpassing 407805 (durable goods orders) indicate robust demand, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS being above thresholds, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
